def valid(text):
    """题面：一行两个整数 n k，1<=n<=1000，0<=k<=1000。"""
    m = re.fullmatch(r'(\d+) (\d+)\n', text)
    if not m:
        return False
    n, k = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
    return 1 <= n <= 1000 and 0 <= k <= 1000

    return True
